result.reason: The operative clause includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at $1M/$2M, E&O at $2M, cyber/privacy at $5M for processing Licensee data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It leaves the existing representation-by-counsel provision unchanged. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after expiration—including CGL and workers’ compensation—goes beyond the playbook and is not narrowly tailored; any post-termination requirement should generally be limited and appropriately drafted for claims-made E&O and cyber coverage.
